title: Environmental Code of the Republic of Tajikistan (Кодекси экологии Ҷумҳурии Тоҷикистон)
citation: Environmental Code of the Republic of Tajikistan of 21 October 2026, No. 2299; adopted by resolution of the Majlisi Namoyandagon of 26 June 2026 No. 540 and approved by resolution of the Majlisi Milli No. 238
evidence: Adlia header, opened 2026-11-03: "Кодекси экологии Ҷумҳурии Тоҷикистон аз 21 октябри соли 2026, № 2299 ... Санаи амалкуни: [empty] Ҳолати ҳуҷҷат: Амалкунанда"; the text carries "Бо қарори Маҷлиси намояндагони Маҷлиси Олии Ҷумҳурии Тоҷикистон аз 26 июни соли 2026, №540 қабул гардидааст" and "Бо қарори Маҷлиси миллии ... аз 17 октябри соли 2026, №238 ҷонибдорӣ гардидааст"; the table of contents ends with "Моддаи 497. Тартиби мавриди амал қарор додани Кодекси мазкур". The effective-date field is empty and article 497 is cut off, so no official page read states the first in-force date.
notes: The brief described this as a December 2025 draft; the Adlia record is the enacted Code (status Амалкунанда, number 2299, 21 October 2026, 497 articles in the table of contents), so the register row is not marked proposed. The Russian text of the same page gives the Majlisi Milli resolution as "от 17 октября 2023 года, №238" where the Tajik text says 2026; the Tajik text is followed. Article 496 is titled "Дар бораи аз эътибор соқит донистани баъзе санадҳои қонунгузории Ҷумҳурии Тоҷикистон" (on repeal of some legislative acts): which acts it repeals was not readable, so whether it replaces tj-law-env-protection-2011 is unverified, and the 2011 Law is listed as in force on Adlia. The table of contents shows an article on eco-labelling (Моддаи 55. Тамғагузории экологӣ), polluter-pays and green-procurement principles and waste duties of legal entities; detailed company duties were not read. Adlia serves anonymous readers only the table of contents, the header and the first article, then '...' (full text needs a paid subscription, see row TJ-ADLIA-CONSOLIDATED), so no text is stored and the commencement article could not be read. No government English: the Adlia page holds Tajik and Russian blocks only and its English switch (https://mmih.adlia.tj/Home/SetCulture?lang=en) answered HTTP 500; the Majlisi Oli site is blocked from the cloud address (row TJ-MAJLISI-ADOPTED). Languages offered by the repository: Tajik and Russian.

title: Resolution of the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan No. 170 of 28 March 2026 approving the Classification System (Taxonomy) of Green Projects
citation: Government Resolution of 28 March 2026, No. 170, "On the Classification System (Taxonomy) of Green Projects" (Қарори Ҳукумати ҶТ аз 28 марти соли 2026, №170), under art. 18 of the Constitutional Law on the Government; the System implements the Strategy for Green Economy Development 2023-2037
evidence: Adlia, opened 2026-11-03: the resolution has two points ("1. Низоми гурӯҳбандии (таксономияи) лоиҳаҳои «сабз» тасдиқ карда шавад (замима мегардад)." and an instruction to ministries, local bodies, enterprises and institutions) and no commencement clause; status Амалкунанда, "Санаи амалкуни" empty. The NBT PDFs open with "Утверждена постановлением Правительства Республики Таджикистан от «28» марта 2026 года, № 170". The issue date is taken as the first in-force date under the lookup policy for acts with no commencement clause (Varun, 2026-11-02, stated for circulars and notices; applied here to a Government resolution).
notes: Stored from nbt.tj, not from Adlia (Adlia's annex is cut off after the heading): Russian (ru) from the PDF text layer (pdftotext -layout, 36 pages) and Tajik (tg) as uncorrected OCR output of the NBT PDF (34 pages, tesseract 5.3.4 --oem 1 -l tgk on pages rendered at 300 dpi): the PDF's own Tajik text layer substitutes Cyrillic letters for the Tajik ones (њ, ќ, ї, љ, ў, ѓ for ҳ, қ, ӣ, ҷ, ӯ, ғ in some 700 places), so it was not used. The OCR has its own errors, mostly in numbers and list marks: 32 of about 1,030 numeric tokens differ from the Russian text (for example the resolution number printed as "ХҲе170", "б)" for "6)"), so quantitative thresholds should be read in the Russian record. The OCR text was not corrected or reflowed by hand. Both files are the Annex only (the System); the two-point cover resolution is on the Adlia page and is not stored. The NBT PDFs carry the file name stamp ДИП 20.02.26 and were not compared with the Adlia annex, so they may be a pre-signature layout of the same System; the header names Resolution No. 170. No government English: the Adlia page holds Tajik and Russian blocks only (its English switch answered HTTP 500) and https://nbt.tj/en/suboti-moliyavi/stable-financing/index.php lists no English materials. The Government resolution is a voluntary classification for green projects and finance, issued by the Government, hosted by the National Bank; no NBT regulation making it mandatory was found.
